talents.label: Twinshot
talents.description: Basic attacks have a 20% chance to fire a second shot. Bonus shots cannot trigger another Twinshot.

talents.label: Steady momentum
talents.description: Each basic attack that does not Twinshot adds 5 percentage points to the next basic Twinshot chance. Resets after a Twinshot. Rank 2: Each basic attack that does not Twinshot adds 10 percentage points to the next basic Twinshot chance. Resets after a Twinshot.
rankDescriptions: Each basic attack that does not Twinshot adds 5 percentage points to the next basic Twinshot chance. Resets after a Twinshot.
Each basic attack that does not Twinshot adds 10 percentage points to the next basic Twinshot chance. Resets after a Twinshot.

talents.label: Arrowstorm
talents.description: Triggering Twinshot increases your attack speed by 5%, up to 25%
rankDescriptions: Triggering Twinshot increases your attack speed by 5%, up to 25%.
Triggering Twinshot increases your attack speed by 10%, up to 50%.

talents.label: Double Tap
talents.description: Draw a heavy shot with a 20% chance to fire twice. A bonus Twinshot has a 20% chance to reset this cooldown and make your next Twinshot instant for ten seconds.

talents.label: Thorn guard
talents.description: +1 primary damage · +1 special damage per rank

talents.label: Wild reprisal
talents.description: +1 primary damage · +2 special damage per rank

talents.label: Combined Assault
talents.description: Causes your pet and you to attack the target at the same time for extra damage.

talents.label: Beastmaster
talents.description: You can tame any creature at or below your level to become your permanent combat companion. Any heal you receive also effects your pet.

talents.label: Everlasting Bond
talents.description: Your companion's basic attacks causes your next basic attack to do extra damage and heal your pet for a percentage of their health

talents.label: Toxic arrows
talents.description: Convert 60% of basic-attack damage into poison over four seconds. Reapplying adds all remaining damage to the new poison.

talents.label: Lingering venom
talents.description: Toxic Arrows lasts six seconds. Reapplying still preserves all remaining poison damage. Rank 2: Toxic Arrows lasts eight seconds. Reapplying still preserves all remaining poison damage.
rankDescriptions: Toxic Arrows lasts five seconds. Reapplying still preserves all remaining poison damage.
Toxic Arrows lasts six seconds. Reapplying still preserves all remaining poison damage.

talents.label: Venom Detonation
talents.description: Consume your poisons on enemies within twelve meters, immediately dealing their remaining damage, increased by 5% for each different damage-over-time effect of yours on that enemy.

talents.label: Defiant strike
talents.description: +1 primary damage · +1 special damage per rank

talents.label: Unyielding force
talents.description: +1 primary damage · +2 special damage per rank

talents.label: Battle rhythm
talents.description: +2% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Commanding force
talents.description: +2% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Veteran’s guard
talents.description: +3% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Heavy strikes
talents.description: +2% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Siegebreaker
talents.description: +2% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Battleplate
talents.description: +3% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Conqueror’s edge
talents.description: +3% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: War standard
talents.description: +3% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Burning
talents.description: Damaging fire spells grant one Heat for six seconds, up to ten. Each Heat increases spell cast speed and all damage-over-time tick rates by 3%.

talents.label: Living flame
talents.description: Your damage-over-time ticks also grant one Heat and refresh Burning. Rank 2: Your damage-over-time ticks also grant two Heat and refresh Burning.
rankDescriptions: Your damage-over-time ticks also grant one Heat and refresh Burning.
Your damage-over-time ticks also grant two Heat and refresh Burning.

talents.label: Combustion
talents.description: Prepare a massive fire strike that leaves a powerful six-second burn. Burning heat speeds up the cast and its damage-over-time ticks.

talents.label: Arcane Echo
talents.description: Damaging arcane spells have a 15% chance to launch an Arcane Missile. These missiles can repeat, up to sixteen echoes per chain.

talents.label: Ley study surge
talents.description: +2% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Resonance
talents.description: Arcane Echo chance increases to 20%, including repeat missiles. Rank 2: Arcane Echo chance increases to 25%, including repeat missiles.
rankDescriptions: Arcane Echo chance increases to 20%, including repeat missiles.
Arcane Echo chance increases to 25%, including repeat missiles.

talents.label: Astral power surge
talents.description: +3% cast and channel damage per rank

talents.label: Arcane Volley
talents.description: Fire seven Arcane Missiles divided among up to seven enemies. One missile guarantees an Arcane Echo; every other hit and echo uses your normal repeat chance. This volley and its echoes deal 40% damage against players.

talents.label: Chilled
talents.description: Damaging frost spells Chill targets for four seconds, slowing them by 20%. Ice Lance deals triple damage to Chilled targets and resets its cooldown when it hits them.

talents.label: Winter study surge
talents.description: +2% direct damage against slowed enemies per rank

talents.label: Deep chill
talents.description: Chilled targets take 5% more damage from all your frost spells. Rank 2: Chilled targets take 10% more damage from all your frost spells.
rankDescriptions: Chilled targets take 5% more damage from all your frost spells.
Chilled targets take 10% more damage from all your frost spells.

talents.label: Shattering cold surge
talents.description: +3% direct damage against slowed enemies per rank

talents.label: Shatter
talents.description: Consume Chilled effects within eighteen meters, immediately striking those enemies with frost and making each explode onto enemies within three meters.
